dashboard.heading: Your work at a glance
dashboard.description: Claude · Codex usage statistics per request
dashboard.billingMode: Billing method for the selected session
dashboard.costNote: Subscription usage costs 0. Prepaid API costs are estimates (USD) calculated from recorded models, tokens, and standard rates; actual charges and balances may differ. Select a session to set an unconfirmed billing method. The choice applies to the entire session and is saved. Costs with unknown rates or token breakdowns are shown as unconfirmed and excluded from totals. Tool fees, discounts, fast processing, long context, and cache retention surcharges are excluded.
dashboard.modelNote: Model request counts include every request using that model; requests using multiple models count under each model. Duration and average time use the full duration of those requests. Models that cannot be identified appear as Unknown. Records with neither a model nor token usage are excluded from charts and averages by default but remain in the table. You can include them in settings.
dashboard.tokenNote: Input excludes cache tokens, Output is generated output, Cache write creates cache entries, and Cache read reuses them. Their sum is total tokens. Unknown cache values appear as —.
dashboard.averageNote: Total tokens include in-progress and failed requests. Interrupted Codex requests are excluded. Averages use successfully completed requests only, and time averages exclude requests with unknown duration. Aggregation uses each request's start date.
dashboard.skillsDisabled: Skill statistics are turned off. Existing data is preserved. Re-enable them in settings to recalculate, including AI-initiated calls.
dashboard.aiCallsNote: Counts both explicit user requests and calls selected by the AI.
dashboard.capabilityRatioNote: Usage counts for the selected provider, project, session, and period. Percentages use the total count in each category, independent of pagination. Periods follow the user request's start date; requests without a start time are excluded when a period is specified.
dashboard.capabilityNote: Skills count executions and reads of skill instructions; subagents count creation calls; plugins count their skill and external-tool calls; models count deduplicated responses. External tools appear under the MCP server name. Codex batch calls are counted from recorded call code and may differ from actual loop or conditional executions. Only recorded usage is included, with unknown models shown separately. Interrupted Codex requests are excluded.
diagnostics.description: View saved processing status. Original logs are checked and statistics recalculated when you reopen Usage Statistics.
diagnostics.qualityNote: Requests with recorded quality warnings or refresh failures. Warnings alone do not exclude requests from statistics; failed refreshes retain the previous valid values.
manifest.description: Claude and Codex subscription usage and local token statistics per user request
manifest.configureColor: Agent Tracker: Choose Status Bar Color
manifest.claudeEnabled: Track Claude Code. Turning this off stops usage lookups and original log collection, and hides Claude from statistics. Existing statistics data is preserved.
manifest.codexEnabled: Track Codex. Turning this off stops usage lookups and original log collection, and hides Codex from statistics. Existing statistics data is preserved.
manifest.automaticRefreshHelp: Refresh on startup and at the configured interval while the window is active. On returning to the window, refresh if the last successful lookup was at least 5 minutes ago or a lookup failed.
manifest.manualRefreshHelp: Fetch usage only when you click Refresh.
manifest.refreshPolicy: Refresh policy for current subscription usage. Automatic refresh pauses in inactive windows and increases retry delays after failures. Statistics are calculated only when Usage Statistics is opened.
manifest.pollingInterval: Shared interval in seconds for fetching usage from tracked Claude Code and Codex accounts during automatic refresh. Default: 900 seconds (15 minutes). Minimum: 30 seconds. Unused with manual refresh.
manifest.codexStatusBar: Show Codex in the status bar. Usage lookups continue when hidden.
manifest.percentage: Display the used or remaining percentage.
manifest.detail: Status bar detail level. Detailed shows 7-day and 5-hour usage; Compact shows only 5-hour usage. The tooltip shows all enabled usage periods.
manifest.automaticColor: Follow the current VS Code theme and workspace default status bar color.
manifest.customColor: Use the HEX color in Display: Custom Color.
manifest.colorMode: Color for usage logos, remaining-usage bars, text, and the refresh button. Automatic follows the current theme, including 2026 Dark, Light, and high contrast, and workspace color settings. [Choose a color](command:agentTracker.configureStatusColor)
manifest.hexColor: HEX color for Custom mode. Examples: `#abc`, `#aabbcc`, `#ffffffcc` (with transparency). Click a swatch or enter HEX in [Choose a color](command:agentTracker.configureStatusColor). Invalid values use the theme default color.
manifest.showReserve: Show GPT Reserve usage in the usage card. Reserve is a separate limit reported by the server as gpt-reserve. Shown only when available for your account.
manifest.showResetCredits: Show available Codex usage resets and their next expiry in the usage card. Shown only when provided by the server.
manifest.usageEnabled:
Enable Usage Statistics. Turning this off cancels collection and closes the statistics view without affecting subscription usage lookups.

[Delete statistics data](command:agentTracker.clearUsageData): deletes saved file processing information and aggregated results. Original conversation logs are preserved and recalculated when statistics are reopened.
manifest.skillsEnabled: Count skill, subagent, plugin, and model usage in Skill statistics. AI-initiated calls are included by default. Turning this off stops new counts and hides Skill statistics while preserving existing data. Tokens, API costs, and subscription usage are unaffected. Re-enabling recalculates in the open statistics view, or from original logs the next time it is opened.
manifest.showApiCosts: Show estimated API costs (USD) in the token statistics table. Subscription usage costs 0. Costs with unconfirmed billing, model rates, or token breakdowns are shown separately. Changing this setting queries saved statistics only.
manifest.excludeEmpty: Exclude requests with no identified model and no token usage from charts and averages. They remain in the table. Includes zero-token records with an identified model and actual token usage with an unknown model.
manifest.timezone: IANA time zone for daily and monthly statistics. Leave empty to use the system time zone.
manifest.dataHome: Shared parent folder for Claude and Codex data. Uses `.claude` and `.codex` under this folder. The default `~` is your home directory. Set globally in user settings; applies to subscription usage lookups, statistics, and Claude log retention in all workspaces.
manifest.cleanupDays: Automatic deletion period for Claude Code conversation logs, in days. A value of at least 1 writes `cleanupPeriodDays` to `settings.json` in the Claude data home. `null` preserves existing settings; Claude defaults to 30 days. Claude Code deletes logs on startup. Already deleted logs cannot be recovered.
manifest.codexExecutable: Codex CLI executable path or command on PATH.
manifest.languageDescription: Choose the extension UI language. By default, follows the VS Code display language. Unsupported languages and missing translations use Korean. Command Palette and VS Code settings descriptions follow the VS Code display language.
